case_title.correct_value: State of N.C.T. of Delhi v. Ajay Kumar Tyagi
case_title.quote: STATE OF N.C.T. OF DELHI v. AJAY KUMAR TYAGI
case_title.reason: Case title matches the judgment heading.

accused_gender.quote: prayed for quashing of the first information report lodged against him
accused_gender.reason: Accused is referred to with male pronouns.

accused_age.reason: The judgment never states the accused's age.

accused_religion.reason: Religion is not mentioned in the judgment.

accused_caste.reason: Caste is not mentioned in the judgment.

accused_occupation.correct_value: Junior Engineer with the Delhi Jal Board
accused_occupation.quote: working as a Junior Engineer with the Delhi Jal Board

previous_criminal_record.reason: No prior criminal record is mentioned.

victim_gender.quote: Constable Surinder Singh ... water connection in the name of his wife
victim_gender.reason: Complainant Constable Surinder Singh is male per the text.

victim_age.reason: No age is given for the complainant or victim.

accused_victim_relationship.quote: Constable Surinder Singh lodged a report with the Anti Corruption Branch
accused_victim_relationship.reason: Judgment gives no 'stranger' relationship; complainant was an applicant before the accused's office.

offence_category.correct_value: Corruption (demand and acceptance of illegal gratification under Prevention of Corruption Act)
offence_category.quote: the accused demanded bribe of Rs. 2000/- for clearing the file
offence_category.reason: Offence is bribery under the Prevention of Corruption Act, not criminal breach of trust.

statutory_provisions.correct_value: Prevention of Corruption Act, 1988 ss. 7 and 13
statutory_provisions.quote: This led to registration of the first information report under Section 7/13 of the Prevention of Corruption Act.
statutory_provisions.reason: Sections 7/13 are right but the Act is wrongly identified as IPC.

weapon.reason: No weapon is mentioned in the judgment.

evidence_type.quote: the accused demanded and accepted the bribe of Rs. 1000/-
evidence_type.reason: Judgment does not classify the evidence as circumstantial; it describes a trap and complaint.

confession.reason: Judgment mentions no confession, so 'None' is not affirmatively supported.

trial_court_outcome.quote: charge-sheet was submitted on 19th of September, 2002 and the accused was put on trial. Charges were framed by the Special Judge.
trial_court_outcome.reason: Judgment shows only that the accused was put on trial; no conviction is recorded.

high_court_outcome.correct_value: High Court quashed the criminal proceedings under s. 482 Cr.P.C.
high_court_outcome.quote: High Court quashed the criminal proceedings.
high_court_outcome.reason: High Court quashed the criminal proceedings; 'Not applicable' is wrong.

final_outcome.correct_value: Appeal allowed; High Court order quashing criminal proceedings set aside; trial to continue
final_outcome.quote: the appeal is allowed, the order of the High Court is set aside with the direction aforesaid.
final_outcome.reason: No conviction; Supreme Court allowed the State's appeal and set aside the High Court order.

offence_finally_established.reason: No offence was finally established; the criminal case remained pending.

imprisonment_type.reason: No sentence is imposed or discussed in the judgment.

imprisonment_years.reason: No term of imprisonment is mentioned anywhere.

fine_rs.reason: No fine is mentioned, so null is appropriate.

neutral_facts.correct_value: Facts stated without the final sentences revealing the Supreme Court's outcome (overturning the High Court and directing the accused to appear before the trial court).
neutral_facts.quote: The Supreme Court overturned the High Court's decision... The accused was ordered to appear before the trial court
neutral_facts.reason: Background facts are accurate, but the last two sentences reveal the court outcome, which is prohibited.

offence_severity.reason: Severity is not characterised in the judgment.

attempt_completion.reason: Judgment reports the alleged acceptance but does not expressly classify completion.

number_of_offences.correct_value: Not stated (charges framed under ss. 7 and 13 of the PC Act; no finding on counts)
number_of_offences.quote: criminal prosecution u/s 7/13 of Prevention of Corruption Act
number_of_offences.reason: Judgment does not state that both counts were finally upheld; no final finding exists.

financial_property_loss.quote: the accused demanded and accepted the bribe of Rs. 1000/-
financial_property_loss.reason: 'Not applicable' ignores the alleged Rs. 1000 bribe, which is the financial element.

premeditation_planning.reason: No premeditation is discussed beyond the trap laid by the Anti Corruption Branch.

motive.correct_value: Illegal gratification (bribe) for clearing the water connection file
motive.quote: demanded bribe of Rs. 2000/- for clearing the file
motive.reason: Judgment states the bribe demand was for clearing the file, so motive is identified.

key_evidence_accepted.correct_value: Not stated (only the enquiry officer's departmental finding is recorded; no criminal evidence is accepted)
key_evidence_accepted.quote: the evidence on record does not substantiate the charge of demand and acceptance of bribe
key_evidence_accepted.reason: Quote is accurate but is a departmental finding, not evidence accepted in the criminal case.

trial_duration.correct_value: Not stated (25.8.2008 is the date of the High Court order, not a trial judgment)
trial_duration.quote: From the Judgment & Order dated 25.8.2008 of the High Court of Delhi
trial_duration.reason: 25.8.2008 is the High Court order date, not a trial judgment; no trial duration is given.

legal_representation.correct_value: For the appellant: J.S. Attry, Anjani Aiyagari, Gargi Khanna, B.V. Bairam Das. For the respondent: Chelan Sharma, Bake Bihari Sharma (for Asha Gopalan Nair).
legal_representation.quote: J.S. Attry, Anjani Aiyagari, Gargi Khanna, B.V. Bairam Das for the Appellant. Chelan Sharma, Bake Bihari Sharma (for Asha Gopalan Nair) for the Respodent.
legal_representation.reason: Counsel names match the appearance block.

investigation_status.correct_value: Charge-sheet filed 19 September 2002; trial pending; departmental proceedings kept in abeyance pending criminal case
investigation_status.quote: charge-sheet was submitted on 19th of September, 2002 and the accused was put on trial
investigation_status.reason: Charge-sheet date is right but 'trial completed' is contradicted; the criminal case is pending.

procedural_irregularity.reason: No procedural irregularity is identified; only a conflict in precedents led to a reference.

appeal_history.correct_value: Writ petition by accused dismissed by High Court; High Court quashed criminal proceedings under s. 482; State appealed and Supreme Court allowed the appeal and set aside the High Court order.
appeal_history.quote: High Court quashed the criminal proceedings... State filed appeal to this Court.
appeal_history.reason: The writ petition was not a trial-court step; the 'Trial court' label is wrong, though the rest is accurate.

prosecution_argument.correct_value: The State argued the High Court's assumption of exoneration was unfounded because the enquiry officer's report was not final and the disciplinary authority could still disagree.
prosecution_argument.quote: the report of the enquiry officer was not the final verdict and the same was yet to be considered by the disciplinary authority
prosecution_argument.reason: Core argument is correct, but the conditional-exoneration point was the Court's observation, not the State's argument.

defence_argument.correct_value: Accused had been exonerated in departmental proceedings and criminal proceedings should be quashed on that ground, relying on P.S. Rajya.
defence_argument.quote: since the accused has been exonerated in the disciplinary proceeding by a detailed speaking order, the first information report deserves to be quashed on that ground alone. Reliance was placed on ... P.S. Rajya
defence_argument.reason: Defence argument and reliance on P.S. Rajya match the judgment.

legal_principle_applied.correct_value: Exoneration in departmental proceedings does not ipso facto lead to quashing or acquittal; standard of proof in departmental proceedings is lower.
legal_principle_applied.quote: exoneration in departmental proceeding ipso facto would not lead to exoneration or acquittal in a criminal case

precedent_relied_upon.correct_value: State v. M. Krishna Mohan (2007) 14 SCC 667; Supdt. of Police (C.B.I.) v. Deepak Chowdhary (1995) 6 SCC 225; CBI v. V.K. Bhutiani (2009) 10 SCC 674; P.S. Rajya v. State of Bihar (1996) 9 SCC 1 (distinguished); State of Haryana v. Bhajan Lal (referred to)
precedent_relied_upon.quote: State v. M. Krishna Mohan (2007) 14 SCC 667
precedent_relied_upon.reason: Lists P.S. Rajya as relied upon though it was distinguished; omits Bhajan Lal, which was referred to.

sentencing_rationale.reason: No sentencing is addressed in the judgment.

judicial_mitigating_factors.reason: The judgment does not discuss mitigating factors, so 'None' is not supported.

judicial_aggravating_factors.reason: The judgment does not discuss aggravating factors, so 'None' is not supported.

other_sentence_order.correct_value: Accused directed to appear before the trial court within four weeks; trial to be expedited and unnecessary adjournments avoided.
other_sentence_order.quote: Accused shall appear before the trial court within four weeks from to-day.
other_sentence_order.reason: The Court issued a direction to appear and expedite trial, so 'None' is wrong.
